description: List vouchers — receipts and incoming/outgoing bills. Status: 50 draft, 100 unpaid/due, 1000 paid. credit_debit C = credit (revenue), D = debit (expense). sevdesk: GET /Voucher.

contact_id.description: Only vouchers for this contact id.

count_all.description: If true, the response also carries `total`, the full match count.

credit_debit.description: C for credit (revenue) or D for debit (expense) vouchers.

description_like.description: Only vouchers whose description contains this text.

embed.description: Comma-separated nested resources to expand inline, e.g. contact,category.

end_date.description: Only vouchers dated on or before this, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip, for paging.

start_date.description: Only vouchers dated on or after this, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

status.description: Only vouchers with this status code.

name: sevdesk_list_vouchers
title: List vouchers (receipts)
